# Code of Conduct

We pledge to provide a welcoming, respectful, harassment-free community. Be constructive, assume good intent, respect boundaries and attribution, and focus criticism on ideas and evidence. Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, discrimination, threats, doxxing, sexualized conduct, and sustained disruption. Report concerns privately to project maintainers through repository moderation channels. Maintainers may remove content or participation that violates this policy.
